messages:
jeff (infra): Heads-up — after last night's driver/kernel update on staging-gpu we started seeing Xid and NCCL watchdog alerts. Creating a single thread to capture monitoring, quick triage steps, and a short runbook.
infra-bot: [ALERT] gpu.xid_rate high - staging-us-east-1 - 24 nodes affected :warning:
anya (oncall): Noted at 02:14 UTC. First spikes on g4-01 and g4-03. dmesg shows repeated 'Xid 79' and 'NCCL watchdog' entries.
sophia (ml-infra): Which driver/kernel combo rolled? I remember we upgraded kernel to 6.4.0-1 and nvidia-driver to 535.60 in the staging deploy.
jeff (infra): Correct. Previous stable was kernel 6.1 + driver 535.54. Symptoms look like a driver<->kernel compatibility regression — Xid 79 often indicates a GPU page fault after a context switch, per earlier incidents.
tara (sched): Quick checklist for oncall — can we write a compact runbook for immediate response? I'll follow it.
jeff (infra): TL;DR runbook (short):

1) Confirm affected nodes
   - kubectl get nodes -l pool=gpu -o wide
   - Check recent dmesg for Xid/NCCL:
     ```
     kubectl -n kube-system logs -l kube-role=gpu-node --tail=200 | grep -E "Xid|NCCL watchdog|nccl" -i
     # or on node:
     sudo dmesg | grep -i "Xid\\|NCCL"
     ```

2) Identify error classes
   - Xid 13/79/86 are different: 13 often driver bug, 79 page fault, 86 ECC/firmware-ish. Look at full dmesg around the timestamp.

3) Short mitigation (staging only)
   - Cordon & drain the node to avoid job failures:
     ```sh
     kubectl cordon <node>
     kubectl drain <node> --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --pod-selector='app!=infra-agent'
     ```
   - Reboot the node to reinitialize kernel/driver state: `sudo reboot`
   - If reboot doesn't clear Xid, roll back the driver to last-known-good (staging):
     ```sh
     apt-get install nvidia-driver-535=535.54-1
     systemctl restart nvidia-persistenced || true
     ```

4) If NCCL watchdog persists
   - Check for long-running stuck collectives in logs. Example NCCL line:
     ```
     [2025-03-12 02:13:24] NCCL WARN NET/Plugin : Watchdog triggered, rank 2 timeout waiting for barrier
     ```
   - If multiple ranks show watchdogs, isolate by cordoning the gpu-pool and failing over to CPU/backfill.

5) Postmortem hooks
   - Capture full dmesg, nvidia-smi -q, /var/log/messages. Attach to the incident thread.
   - Tag the kernel/driver versions, which docker images were running GPU workloads, and any relevant pod ids.

jeff (infra): Prometheus/Grafana alert suggestion (PromQL snippet):
```promql
sum(rate(node_dmesg_errors{message=~"(?i).*Xid.*|.*NCCL.*|.*nccl.*"}[5m])) by (cluster, node) > 0
```
Use for a P0 alert in staging and P1 in prod with a higher threshold/aggregation.
anya (oncall): Adding a note — group alerts per node and auto-suppress duplicates for 10m to avoid pager storms. Also surfaced 3 different Xid codes across nodes, so we should include the exact code in the alert label.
sophia (ml-infra): For longer-term: add a driver sanity check step to CI that runs a short CUDA kernel + multi-node NCCL ring on a tiny cluster before rolling drivers. Sample preflight script:
```sh
# quick sanity: run simple cuda device query + nccl allreduce smoke
python tests/nccl_smoke.py --nodes 2 --reps 3
```
This would catch basic NCCL/memory regressions early.
tara (sched): Operational automation idea: on alert, auto-cordon nodes then notify oncall with a checklist link. We should be conservative in prod (no auto-drain), but staging auto-remediate is fine.
deploy-bot: Deployed: staging-driver-bump-2025-03-12 v1 -> staged to 24/24 nodes (pipeline #4821)
jeff (infra): Action items from this thread:
- [anya] collect full logs for the 6 earliest nodes and upload to the incident S3 bucket. (ETA 30m)
- [sophia] draft CI preflight + push to infra-tests repo. (ETA EOD)
- [tara] add alert rule for Xid codes + grouping, suppression window, and link to runbook. (ETA EOD)
- [jeff] prepare a rollback playbook and driver package pinned to 535.54 for quick apt rollback.

anya (oncall): I'm uploading logs now. First batch links: s3://redwood-incidents/staging/xid-20250312/g4-01.tar.gz (upload in progress)
sophia (ml-infra): I'll open a PR to infra-tests with the nccl_smoke.py skeleton and a note about where to run it in the pipeline.
jeff (infra): Thanks all. After we verify staging cleared, we'll schedule a cautious canary in prod with enhanced metrics and a 30m hold window. :thumbsup:
tara (sched): +1, will trace the rollout pipeline and add the annotation hook for preflight.
infra-bot: [RESOLVED] gpu.xid_rate - staging-us-east-1 - alerts returned to baseline at 03:08 UTC :white_check_mark:
jeff (infra): Closing the loop — will post a short incident summary once logs and PRs are in. If anyone sees recurrence DM me.
